notes.title: “Do this in remembrance of Me”
notes.intro: Luke’s account of the Last Supper includes Jesus’ command to repeat the meal.

views.label: Remembrance that makes Christ’s sacrifice present
views.summary: Catholic and Orthodox Christians understand “remembrance” (anamnesis) as more than recalling: the one sacrifice of Christ is made present in the Eucharist.

views.label: A memorial in which Christ is truly given
views.summary: Lutherans, Anglicans and Reformed Christians speak of a memorial in which Christ himself is present and received.
views.source: Augsburg Confession, Article X; Westminster Confession 29

views.label: A memorial and proclamation
views.summary: Many evangelicals see the Supper chiefly as remembering Christ’s death and proclaiming it until he comes.
views.source: Baptist Faith and Message (2000), Article VII
